What We Restore

Different Materials. Different Damage. The Same Standard of Care.

Textiles respond differently to fire, smoke, soot, water, heat, residue, and cleaning. There is no single treatment for every item.

Professional restoration starts by understanding the material in front of you.

American Clothing Restoration focuses on the clothing and textile side of a property loss. The work begins with the condition of the item, the material, and what happened to it.

Clothing & Garments

Professional care for affected everyday clothing, professional attire, and other garments.

Household Textiles

Care for recoverable fabric-based household belongings affected by a property loss.

Bedding & Linens

Professional textile care for household linens where restoration is practical.

Drapery & Window Textiles

Fabric window treatments may be considered for restoration depending on material and condition.

Specialty Garments

Certain formal and specialty garments may require more detailed handling and finishing.
